<blog>
# Presenton: Open-Source AI Presentation Generator

## 1. Project Introduction

Presenton is an open-source AI-powered presentation generator that serves as a self-hosted alternative to commercial tools like Gamma, Canva, and Beautiful AI. The project enables users to create professional presentations from prompts, uploaded documents, or custom PowerPoint templates using multiple AI providers including OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, Ollama, and many others.

### Core Goals and Objectives

- **Full Control**: No SaaS lock-in, no forced subscriptions, complete control over models and data
- **Multi-Platform Support**: Available as Docker deployment, Electron desktop app (Windows/macOS/Linux), and web interface
- **Flexible AI Integration**: Support for diverse LLM providers and image generation services
- **Professional Output**: Export to fully editable PowerPoint (.pptx) and PDF formats
- **Open Source**: Apache 2.0 licensed with transparent codebase

### Target Audience

- Organizations requiring private, self-hosted presentation solutions
- Developers building AI-powered presentation tools
- Users seeking alternatives to subscription-based presentation platforms
- Teams needing customizable presentation workflows with their own branding

## 2. Technical Architecture

Presenton follows a modern microservices architecture with clear separation of concerns across frontend, backend, and desktop components.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Electron Desktop App] --> B[Next.js Frontend]
    C[Docker Deployment] --> B
    D[Web Browser] --> B
    
    B --> E[FastAPI Backend]
    E --> F[Database Layer]
    E --> G[AI Provider Services]
    E --> H[Template Engine]
    
    I[External AI Providers] --> G
    J[Image Generation APIs] --> G
    K[Document Processing] --> E
    
    L[File System] --> F
    M[Local Storage] --> F
```

### Component Breakdown

**Frontend Layer (Next.js)**
- Modern React application with TypeScript
- Rich slide editor with drag-and-drop functionality
- Real-time collaboration features
- Template preview and customization interface

**Backend Layer (FastAPI)**
- RESTful API endpoints for all operations
- Asynchronous task processing for long-running operations
- Multi-user authentication and authorization
- Template management and generation engine

**Desktop Layer (Electron)**
- Cross-platform native application wrapper
- Local server orchestration
- File system integration
- System-level features (file dialogs, notifications)

### Design Patterns

- **Service-Oriented Architecture**: Clear separation between API routes, business logic, and data access
- **Repository Pattern**: Database operations abstracted through service classes
- **Strategy Pattern**: Multiple AI provider implementations with unified interfaces
- **Observer Pattern**: Real-time updates and event handling
- **Factory Pattern**: Dynamic component and template instantiation

## 3. Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

**Backend Server** (`servers/fastapi/server.py`)
- Uvicorn-based FastAPI server configuration
- Command-line argument parsing for port and logging
- Development mode support with hot reloading

**Application Router** (`servers/fastapi/api/main.py`)
- Central FastAPI application initialization
- Middleware configuration (CORS, authentication, session management)
- Route registration for v1 and v2 API versions
- Static file serving and asset mounting

**Electron Main Process** (`electron/app/main.ts`)
- Native application lifecycle management
- Child process orchestration for backend servers
- Security configurations and sandboxing
- System integration features

### Core Modules

**Presentation Model** (`servers/fastapi/models/sql/presentation.py`)
- SQLAlchemy ORM model for presentation data persistence
- Version tracking for presentation format evolution
- JSON field storage for flexible content structures
- User ownership and relationship management

**Template Generation Engine** (`servers/fastapi/templates/v2/generation.py`)
- Advanced template layout generation using AI
- Component merging and deduplication algorithms
- Parallel processing for improved performance
- Schema validation and error recovery

**Document Conversion Service** (`servers/fastapi/services/document_conversion_service.py`)
- Image format conversion and optimization
- Memory-efficient processing pipeline
- Error handling and logging
- Temporary file management

### Configuration Approach

**Environment Configuration** (`servers/fastapi/utils/get_env.py`)
- Centralized environment variable management
- Type-safe configuration loading
- Default value handling and validation
- Multi-environment support (development, production, testing)

**Dependency Management** (`servers/fastapi/pyproject.toml`, `servers/nexjs/package.json`)
- Python dependencies managed via uv/PyProject
- Node.js dependencies via npm package manager
- Version pinning for reproducibility
- Development and production dependency separation

### External Dependencies

**Core Frameworks**
- FastAPI + Uvicorn for high-performance async backend
- Next.js 16 + React 19 for modern frontend
- Electron for cross-platform desktop distribution
- SQLAlchemy + Alembic for database migrations

**AI/ML Libraries**
- OpenAI SDK for text generation
- Google GenAI for Gemini integration
- Mem0 for presentation memory and context
- FastEmbed for vector embeddings

**Document Processing**
- python-pptx for PowerPoint manipulation
- Pillow for image processing
- pdfplumber for PDF extraction
- LiteParse for document parsing

### Integration Points

**AI Provider Abstraction** (`servers/fastapi/utils/llm_provider.py`)
- Unified interface for multiple LLM providers
- Automatic fallback and retry mechanisms
- Rate limiting and quota management
- Response normalization and error handling

**Authentication System** (`servers/fastapi/api/v1/auth/router.py`)
- Multi-user authentication with role-based access
- JWT token management
- OAuth integration for external providers
- Session management and security middleware

**Export Pipeline** (`servers/fastapi/services/export_task_service.py`)
- Asynchronous export job processing
- Multiple output format support (PPTX, PDF)
- Progress tracking and status reporting
- Resource cleanup and error recovery

## 4. Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**AI-Powered Presentation Generation**
- Prompt-to-presentation workflow with intelligent content structuring
- Document upload and automatic slide creation
- Customizable tone, verbosity, and style options
- Web search integration for real-time information gathering

**Advanced Template System**
- V2 template architecture with component-based design
- AI-assisted template generation and modification
- Reusable component library with smart matching
- Theme and styling system with CSS/Tailwind support

**Rich Slide Editor**
- Drag-and-drop interface for slide composition
- Real-time preview and editing capabilities
- Chart and infographic support with data visualization
- Math rendering with LaTeX support

**Multi-Provider AI Integration**
- Support for 15+ AI providers (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, etc.)
- Flexible image generation with multiple backends
- Local model support via Ollama integration
- Custom provider configuration for enterprise needs

### Implementation Highlights

**Template V2 System** (`servers/fastapi/templates/v2/`)
- Component-based architecture for reusable slide elements
- AI-driven layout generation with constraint satisfaction
- Performance optimization through parallel processing
- Comprehensive validation and error handling

**Real-Time Collaboration** (`servers/fastapi/services/chat/`)
- WebSocket-based communication for live editing
- Conflict resolution and version synchronization
- Presence detection and user coordination
- Message history and conversation management

**Export Engine** (`servers/fastapi/services/export_task_service.py`)
- High-performance PPTX generation with formatting preservation
- PDF export with proper typography and layout
- Batch processing for multiple presentations
- Quality optimization and compression

### Feature Architecture

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> InputProcessing
    InputProcessing --> ContentGeneration: Valid Input
    InputProcessing --> Error: Invalid Input
    
    ContentGeneration --> OutlineCreation: Structure Analysis
    ContentGeneration --> DirectSlide: Markdown Input
    
    OutlineCreation --> SlideGeneration: Outline Approved
    DirectSlide --> SlideGeneration: Slides Ready
    
    SlideGeneration --> TemplateMatching: Content Ready
    TemplateMatching --> LayoutGeneration: Template Selected
    LayoutGeneration --> ContentEnrichment: Layout Created
    
    ContentEnrichment --> ImageGeneration: Media Required
    ContentEnrichment --> FinalReview: Complete
    
    ImageGeneration --> FinalReview: Images Generated
    FinalReview --> Export: Review Complete
    Export --> [*]: Presentation Ready
    
    Error --> [*]: Retry or Cancel
```

The architecture demonstrates Presenton's comprehensive approach to AI-powered presentation creation, from initial input processing through final export, with robust error handling and multiple generation pathways to accommodate different use cases and user preferences.

</blog>
